title: Rav Safra son of Rav Yeiva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 5a, speaking to Ravina. There, at 9a, the reading is Rav Sama, but Hyman reports Rav Safra as the reading in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Bava Batra 5a paragraph has Rav Safra son of Rav Yeiva addressing Ravina; the whole 9a paragraph instead has Rav Sama son of Rav Yeiva addressing Rav Papa. Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim reading remains an attributed report, without importing the second addressee into his first notice or identifying the two speakers.
